decisive_items: Showed monomorphic population of small to medium-sized hyperchromatic, CD20+ lymphocytes
Systemic evaluation: Showed no other involvement
Ultrasonographic biomicroscopy: Showed ciliary body involvement
response.rationale: CD20+ small-to-medium lymphocytes with no systemic involvement favor a low-grade extranodal marginal zone lymphoma (MALT) arising in the iris; ciliary body involvement is contiguous extension. R1 is broader and lacks the specific histologic subtype, while R4 duplicates R2 with less support.

rejected.why: Primary iris lymphoma is less specific; the biopsy and staging better fit extranodal marginal zone lymphoma.
Too generic; does not specify the lymphoma subtype or incorporate the CD20+ clonal population.
Same entity as R2 but lacks the systemic evaluation support and is less complete.
Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma typically shows large cells, not small-to-medium monomorphic lymphocytes.
Ciliary body involvement is secondary; the primary lesion is the iris nodule.
